guide.1: Rookie, let's practice! Hold to raise a little hill, then dig a hollow.
guide.2: You've got hills, but where's the water? Place a spring in the hollow and watch a lake form.
guide.3: Dress the lakeshore in green! Grow three healthy patches of plants.
guide.4: Even interns need a sunset break. Click 「Watch Sunset」 and don't blink!
guide.5: Liven things up! Add a little animal, and leave it some grass to eat.
guide.6: Recruit your first pair of villagers! One man, one woman. Let their story unfold.
guide.7: No clocking in here; life keeps busy on its own. Select a creature to 「Visit Incognito」!

help: Keyboard: 1–7 basic tools; M miracles, Q switch subtool, E use at crosshair, G skip, N select creature, B visit incognito, Esc return to workstation. Divine Hand: hold and drag a creature, release to put down; press E to pick up, then again to put down. Dream: select a resident, then a task (Z / C / V). O collects shrine offerings. WASD pans, + / − zooms. Rating: 1 star for starting; 4 residents, 3 animal species, each shrine level, and your first fulfilled wish each count as 1 milestone, up to 5 stars. Spending or population changes never remove earned stars.
